statement: The new tree sits at zero on every style rule except registered exceptions used exactly; a scan that did not run cannot pass, and a new directory under pure/ is gated until it is named as outside the gate; a run leaves no planted canary files behind.
source: coordinator 09-30 (PR #71 review: a skipped or deleted gate test must turn the gate red)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-STYLE an ast-grep that exits 0 and prints nothing fails the gate
an ast-grep killed by a signal fails the gate
an ast-grep that prints the canary hit but exits 2 fails the gate
a directory under pure/ that is neither gated nor named as outside the gate is a failing row
a throw, a dead export and a positional boolean each fail by name
an exception fails unless its count is exactly used: too many hits, or a stale row
a bare true, false or undefined passed to a function is a hit
an ignored folder under pure/ (a local db-* from a test run) does not turn the gate red
an ignored file under kernel/ is not counted, and the same file untracked-not-ignored is
a name in a comment or a string of another file is not a user
async function, interface, enum, let and declared forms are exports too
a column-0 comment in the body does not end the declaration
a template literal whose lines start in column 0 does not end the declaration
a same-spelled local in another file is not a user
a file importing its own export is not its own user
a bare specifier that spells a sibling file's name is a package, not that file
import * as ns of a gated file is a hit of its own
a form the gate cannot name is a hit, not a silent pass
a type named only in a comment, or only by itself, is dead
a function whose body starts in column 0 is measured to its closing brace
a union whose members start in column 0 is measured to its end
a throw and a dead export in an .mts file fail by name
a throw, a long line and a dead export in a .tsx file fail by name
a source file directly under pure/ that is neither gated nor named outside the gate is a failing row
an ast-grep that answers the style canary but never the fact canary fails the gate
a rule file that is deleted, with its exception row and its use gone, turns the gate red
a rule that no longer matches its canary is silent, and the gate is red
a canary that does not trigger its own rule is silent, even when that rule reports on another rule's canary
a rule file without a canary is a failing row
every rule reports on its canary in both languages, so the real tree is clean
an import without an extension, or of a directory, resolves to the file or to its index
an interface that is not exported is measured like one that is
a run removes the canary files it planted: the temp folder holds no tree-canary directory afterwards
